name: Quorum
tagline: Argue before you trade — adversarial Bull/Bear/Risk debate, a Judge ruling on the record, dissent never erased.
signatureElement: The lime-topped preserved-minority-opinion block inside the ruling-on-tape card — the losing argument is first-class, never a footnote.

signatureObject.name: ruling-on-tape — a verdict card wearing a terminal window's dot-header, with a lime hairline and a lime-topped dissent panel welded below the ruling
signatureObject.thesis: Quorum's entire thesis is that the losing argument is preserved on the record; the signature makes dissent architecturally first-class (its own lime-topped panel inside the hero) rather than a discardable footnote, and the terminal dot-header asserts 'courtroom inside a trading terminal' at a glance.

perSurface.landing: ruling-on-tape hero card with the lime minority panel visible on first load above the seeded decision feed — the cold-stranger money shot
perSurface.console: dense mono decision feed (/app) and OOS proof panel (/backtest): hairline-bordered metric tables, tabular-nums, equity curve where lime=Panel beats dim=ablation — reading-room density, not a marketing hero
